name: Structural Clarity — Looking-Glass Theme
principle: Utility over ornament. Carroll's wit lives in structure, naming and typography, never in decoration that competes with data.
valueProposition: Translating complex mathematical and legal systems into transparent, high-contrast functional frameworks where Carrollian wit reinforces structural precision.
rules: Red Queen is reserved for Caution and threshold states.
White Rabbit Gold marks the single focal node on any screen.
Brass Hairline is for borders and dividers only, never text.
Color never carries status alone: always pair Red Queen and Gold with text labels or icons.
No illustration, character art, Disney imagery, or decorative flourishes competing with data.

canvas.name: Looking-Glass Slate
canvas.role: Stable grounding canvas for typography, data tables, and matrix layout

boardSquareAlt.name: Board Slate
boardSquareAlt.role: Alternating checkerboard squares on the 12x11 matrix surface

accentAction.name: Cheshire Teal
accentAction.role: Primary action triggers, active component outlines, and nominal telemetry

warmAccent.name: White Rabbit Gold
warmAccent.role: Marks the single focal node on any screen and focal nexus coordinates

thresholdError.name: Red Queen
thresholdError.role: Reserved strictly for Caution, threshold alerts, and adversarial boundaries

bodyType.name: Vellum
bodyType.role: High-legibility running prose, data table cells, and narrative reading

decorativeRules.name: Brass Hairline
decorativeRules.role: Double hairline borders and dividers for cards and tables only (never text)

stamp.name: Courthouse Stamp Teal
stamp.role: Clerk seal, docket stamps, active legal nodes

callingCard.name: Calling Card Terracotta
callingCard.role: Procedural alerts and court docket thresholds

display.fontFamily: EB Garamond, Cormorant Garamond, Garamond, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
display.description: Literary classical display headings and chapter titles; small-caps applied to section labels

body.fontFamily: Space Grotesk, Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
body.description: Geometric clean sans-serif preserved for density, legibility, and high-information reading

technical.fontFamily: JetBrains Mono, Fira Code, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

cognitivePhaseDelay.carrollSubtitle: Running to stay in the same place

sectionHeadings.style: Chapter numerals (Chapter I, Chapter II, Chapter III...)

motion.reducedMotion: All motion disabled under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce

accessibility.standard: WCAG 2.1 AAA (>= 7:1 for all text pairings)
